cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The post's been terrible. We can write the first ones here, bypass the whole system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Sit down; I'll write yours first. You can watch until there's enough to take home.

mechanism: A invokes professional delivery and writing procedure to repair a letter exchange urgently while evading responsibility for unanswered letters.
confusable: D61 hides causing a practical problem; D85 specifically conceals A creating relational distance while urgently repairing it.
comparison: Key alternative evades lock change through access repair and birthday recreation; letters alternative shifts postal blame then offers witnessed writing when that excuse fails.
seedUse: Taxi deadline, paper/stamps, three unanswered letters and hand delivery derive from D85-a; S03 adds correspondence-procedure corrections.
